summary: Mobile web smoke testing covered onboarding, scanner navigation, seeded product detail, ingredient sheet, and backend contracts. Core seeded lookup and API behavior passed; the ingredient sheet close action is not reliably exposed to automation, and guest history ownership is not migrated on registration.

ui_bugs.issue: The close Pressable has no testID or accessibility label and renders without a discoverable button role on web, preventing reliable dismissal automation. Add a stable testID/accessibilityLabel and verify the same control on native.

integration_issues.issue: History is keyed as guest:<guest_id> before registration and user:<id> after registration; registration does not migrate guest history, so earlier scans are likely absent from the registered history screen.

action_items: Add testID/accessibilityLabel to the ingredient sheet close Pressable and validate dismissal on Expo native/web.
On successful registration, migrate or associate existing guest history with the new user before refreshing history.
critical_code_review_comments: The frontend API client reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/Expo extra backendUrl; verify this remains aligned with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL deployment variable.
Expo logs show a non-blocking React Native DevTools Electron --no-sandbox installation error; Metro still bundles and serves successfully.

success_rate.frontend: 75% of attempted checkpoints; core product flow passed, history continuation/close selector blocked

seed_data_creation: Used a unique guest identifier; no persistent seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: First launch and seeded barcode 8901030895001 work on 375x667 web preview. Ingredient sheet opens. Close control lacks stable semantics; use a new testID after fix. Backend pytest passes against the public preview URL.
rca_of_issue: IngredientSheet closeButton is a React Native Pressable wrapping only an Ionicons icon without testID/accessibilityLabel, and Expo web does not expose it as a discoverable button in this rendered state. History is written with owner guest:<guest_id> for guest scans while authenticated history queries user:<id>; no linking/migration occurs during AuthModal onSuccess.
